source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: surveillance AND privacy AND (digital OR technology) AND (power OR state OR citizens)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:surveillance AND privacy AND (digital OR technology) AND (power OR state OR citizens),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("privacy" AND "surveillance" AND ("citizens" OR "power" OR "state") AND ("digital" OR "technology"))
